notes.title: Update V0.15
notes.notes:
• "Roadruler" vehicle is now FREE!
• Added leaf effects for the trees
• Improved car wash particle effects
• Fixed mafia rewards
• Fixed pause menu not resetting when reopened
• Other small improvements and bug fixes

notes.title: Update V0.14
notes.notes:
Hello dear people,
Today I welcome you with a fairly significant update for the game. 

•[b]TWO NEW VEHICLES[/b] - Meteor and Zenith. They can be bought from Car Market
•[b]VEHICLE DIRTY SYSTEM[/b] - Now your cars and trucks can get dirty, so you might want to wash them. I will also add a sponge when the inventory system is ready, to be able to wash the car anywhere, manually
•Fixed laggy vehicles in traffic
•Reworked the object highlighting system
•I also fixed a LOT of bugs.

Maybe I haven't added a lot of stuff now, but I've worked and experimented with a lot more stuff than the ones added, stuff that I'll add soon: inventory, rope system, proper vehicle customization, etc.

Until then, I wish you all happy holidays!

notes.title: Patch Update V0.12
notes.notes:
• Added location discovery
• Improved the gas stations refuel system
• Fixed some wrong colliders
• Other bug fixes and optimizations

I am working on a significant update where I will add many new things to the game. I hope to finish it in the next few days. Until then, I wish you a good day!

notes.title: Patch Update V0.11
notes.notes:
• Added vehicle orbit camera
• Fixed a character bug that would appear when trying to enter a vehicle while another animation was in progress.
• The volume of weather audio effects have been balanced
• Other small fixes and adjustments.

notes.title: Release + Roadmap
notes.notes:
[b]Starting today, Driveland is available to download on Steam. Thank you to everyone who contributed to the completion of this game, and the road does not end here.[/b]

I still have many plans for the future: 

•A new trailer for the game. The current one no longer fully reflects the game, and its quality is primitive. I'm working on one, but I didn't manage to finish it before the release.
•Bug fixing. Very important. I am aware that with the release of the game, there will appear many bugs that have not been seen before.
•Improving the gameplay and adding new systems and functionalities.
•At the same time, I plan that in the future this game will have an [u]Online Mode[/u]. It was one of my wishes from the beginning, but a lot of work is needed.

And many others. In any case, I will announce every important information here and on the Discord server. 

[b]LET'S PLAY![/b]

notes.title: RELEASE DATE - DRIVELAND
notes.notes:
Hello people! I am very excited to announce that [b]the game will be released on December 11, 2024[/b]! Thank you to those who waited so long for this project, I hope it was worth it! 

In the meantime, I'm also working on a new trailer, so stay tuned!

For more details, I recommend you to join our Discord server. Thanks!

notes.title: Small Patch V0.021
notes.notes:
- Fixed some translation errors.
- The coupling of trailers to trucks has been improved.
- Now you can't fill the vehicles with gas if you're out of money.
- Terrain improvements.
- And other small bugs.

notes.title: Update V0.02
notes.notes:
Hello people! [u]Thank you for your support![/u] I saw the bugs you encountered, so this update is a major bug fix, but I also improved some things here and there. 

- Now the camera stays in place in menus or other panels. No more annoying movements!
- In older version, you could spawn another vehicle while already in one, which completely breaks the game. Now that is no longer a problem.
- I redid the missions given by the mafias. Now they have a correct destination.
- Many UI elements have been improved
- I optimized the game where possible, without any decrease in quality.

notes.title: Graphical Improvements & More
notes.notes:
[u]/// Thank you all for the massive support offered! It's unbelievable...[/u]

[b]Hello again, this time with version 0.016 on the table!
I wasn't completely happy with the way the game looked, so that's what I settled on today.[/b]

- The reflections on the map have been significantly improved. 
- The terrain has been improved, adding more details, at least on a part of it.
- Added mushrooms on terrain.
- Also fixed some more bugs.

[u]Next update I will focus on the overall playability of the game, so stay close.[/u]

notes.title: Small Patch V0.015
notes.notes:
Welcome, V0.015 is a small update after your reports.

- Added sound effects when selling items.
- Now you can open the map menu by pressing the M key, as it should be.
- Updated map legend.
- Added missing icons or missing text when unlocking a new vehicle.
- Fixed some small bugs.
